title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass | Polished Brass | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass and designed to coordinate with the Carolina Collection in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures.

  • Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean finished look
  • Installation hardware included (mounting plates and all hardware)
  • Finish options available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specifications

  • Collection: Carolina
  • Category: Towel Bars
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Style: Traditional
  • Shape: Straight bar
  • Center-to-center: 18-Inch
  • Overall length: 20-Inch
  • Bar diameter: 0.75-Inch
  • Projection: 2-Inch
  • Height: 3.5-Inch; Width: 2-Inch
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: The Carolina Collection towel bar from Allied Brass is a blend of elegant form and simplified detail. Made from the finest solid brass materials and finished with a lifetime decorative finish, this traditional towel bar is extremely attractive yet highly functional. The Carolina Collection has bath accessories to meet your design and decorating needs.
